scope: Twelve complete states: original two downhill and matched-flat starts at 13.00/13.14s, original and V48 late-composition states at 85.00/85.12s.
comparisons: Original V15 and V48 standing from each state, original V21 walking fixed; two exact complete continuations per arm.

search.terminal_knot: zero; five preceding 14D residual knots are optimized
search.skip: Only skip a target state if an unmodified comparison arm already passes its full original session.
search.target_states: Four original downhill states plus two V48 late-composition states.
search.budget: At most 2304 candidate trajectories, each to the current 18-second window end or a fall. No extension or parameter retuning.
search.initialization: Each generation and anchor: mean, best-so-far or zero, three incoming-action bridge seeds releasing over .5/1/1.75s, then nineteen Gaussian candidates. Clip search parameters only; never clip actuator outputs.
search.update: Six lowest-cost candidates per anchor; half previous mean/std and half elite mean/std; std floor .02 rad.
search.selection: Single lowest proxy-cost candidate across both anchors; score it on every original gate through the entire remaining 36s or 180s session, and reproduce twice. No alternate checkpoint or candidate selected from validation outcomes.

acceptance: Original window and whole-session evaluators unchanged, including motor/joint/posture/gait/slip/body geometry, 200Hz internal loads, duration and heading. Recovered current window, restart window and complete session are separate outcomes.
boundary: Privileged exposed diagnostic only. Optimization is not PPO, a deployed controller, physical calibration or carpet generalization. Unsuccessful bounded search does not prove impossibility. Fresh/protected banks remain closed.
